backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing access control, user profiles, approval workflows, and chat request management with admin caching and permission checks.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping profile-related Firestore-driven UI features to affected frontend files and components with high-confidence test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Collection of short summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file including screens, utilities, Firebase wrappers, styles, and deployment docs.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment runbook detailing build steps, approval gating checks, troubleshooting, and required console log behaviors ensuring fresh Firestore reads.
frontend/firestore.rules: Firestore security rules defining access for super_admin, helper_admin, and users, covering users, chat requests, chats, and message subcollections with role‑based permissions.
frontend/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers and extensive CSS variables for themes, including light and dark mode tokens.
frontend/index.html: Loads Firebase SDK via CDN, initializes the app, and mounts the React entry point.
frontend/LIVE_SMOKE_TEST.md: End‑to‑end smoke test checklist validating signup flows, approval gating, admin approval effects, Firestore reads, and consistent login behavior.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Implements a client-side router using React state, rendering screens and guards based on the current path.
frontend/src/components/admin/UserRowAct: Provides an admin actions dropdown with dialogs for approving, rejecting, blocking, and promoting users.
frontend/src/components/auth/AdminRouteG: Guards routes by allowing access only to users with admin roles after loading their profile.
frontend/src/components/auth/Authenticat: Restricts access to authenticated users by checking Firebase auth and the user profile.
Wraps auth pages in a centered layout with a footer and simple branding.
frontend/src/components/auth/SuperAdminR: Allows route access only for super admin users, showing a loading indicator during checks.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppHeader: Renders the top navigation bar with logo, user avatar, and profile menu trigger.
frontend/src/components/layout/ProfileMe: Displays a dropdown with profile info, navigation shortcuts, and logout functionality.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useFirebaseAuthUser.t: Hook that waits for CDN-loaded Firebase, loads auth modules, and subscribes to auth state changes to expose the current user.
frontend/src/hooks/useFirestorePendingUs: Hook that fetches pending users and provides approve, reject, block, and promote mutations with react-query invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useFirestoreUserProfi: Hook that loads the authenticated user's profile from Firestore once auth is ready.
frontend/src/hooks/useFirestoreUsersList: Hook that retrieves all users and provides approval and role update mutations with query refresh.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and provider for managing Internet Identity auth state, login flow, and stored identities.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining light/dark theme variables and global base styles.
frontend/src/lib/firebase.ts: CDN-based Firebase wrapper providing Firestore/auth helpers, dynamic module loading, and profile creation utilities.
frontend/src/lib/firebaseErrorMessages.t: Maps Firebase error codes to user-friendly error messages.
frontend/src/lib/firebaseTypes.ts: Defines TypeScript types for user profiles and signup data.
frontend/src/lib/postLoginRedirect.ts: Determines the appropriate post-login route based on user role and approval status.
Utility to resize, compress, and validate profile images client‑side.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Utility function for merging class names using clsx and tailwind-merge.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point setting up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and rendering the app.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminChatsScr: Admin-protected screen showing a placeholder for future chat management.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminDashboar: Admin dashboard summarizing user statistics with loading states and overview cards.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminLayout.t: Shared admin layout providing navigation sidebar, mobile menu, and content container.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminReportsS: Admin-protected screen showing a placeholder for upcoming reporting features.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminSettings: Admin-protected screen with a placeholder for future application settings.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminUsersScr: Admin screen listing pending users with approval, rejection, blocking, and admin role actions.
frontend/src/screens/ChatScreen.tsx: Chat interface that loads user chats and messages, supports sending messages, and manages chat selection and scrolling.
frontend/src/screens/HomeScreen.tsx: Displays a welcome message with basic onboarding and profile management cards.
frontend/src/screens/LoginScreen.tsx: Handles email/password login, error display, profile checks, and redirects based on user status.
frontend/src/screens/PasswordResetScreen: UI-only password reset request form with admin-handled reset flow and confirmation state.
frontend/src/screens/PendingApprovalScre: Shows pending admin approval status with steps and option to return to login.
frontend/src/screens/ProfileScreen.tsx: Fetches and displays user profile details, avatar, and admin role indicators.
frontend/src/screens/SignupScreen.tsx: Signup form screen handling user input, profile photo capture/upload, validation, and sign‑up submission.
frontend/src/screens/users/ApprovedUsers: Displays approved users and manages sending/receiving chat requests using React Query and Firebase helpers.
frontend/src/screens/users/UserManagemen: Admin view for listing all users and updating their approval status via Firebase mutations.
frontend/src/screens/UsersScreen.tsx: Loads current user profile and displays the unified approved users list.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining theme extensions, colors, typography, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing requirements, scope constraints, and pending feature requests for profile data handling.
